experiment: FI-2010 continuous return regression with walk-forward validation selection

dataset.name: FI-2010
dataset.attribution: Ntakaris et al., Journal of Forecasting 37(8), 852-866 (2018), DOI 10.1002/for.2543

method.split: five expanding chronological validation folds inside training file, purge >= horizon
method.selection_metric: mean Pearson IC across training-only validation folds; Rank IC used only as tie-break
method.test_use: selected configuration refit on training file; held-out files scored only after selection
